about: rumblemenu (2026-11-25): a fresh save's Royal Rumble RULES defaults and the NUMBER page's current-setting highlight. The copy's saves set aside, so the game makes a new save (fill_save_with_defaults; the mod's Rumble rules go into its slot 13 through load_rules_preset's hook). Regular, Multi Play > Royal Rumble > ORDER Random > NUMBER (qa_reg 65793 = 1 + 256 + 65536): 2 s as it opens (NUMBER's caption lit), then UP (15 -> 16), RIGHT (IN THE RING lit), UP x2 (6 -> 7 -> 8), RIGHT (ENTRY TIME), RIGHT (STARTS WITH), RIGHT (round to NUMBER), LEFT (STARTS WITH), RIGHT (NUMBER), 2 s on each for its shot; A; PLAYER and ARENA with A; the RULES page as it opens, shots, to the end. state.csv on screen 9 (qa_modes): bs_tries = the captions' lit bytes (+0x57, 0 lit): NUMBER's | IN THE RING's << 8 | ENTRY TIME's << 16 | STARTS WITH's << 24; rr_next = the cursor | rows 2, 4, 6's values << 8, 16, 24. On screen 21: bs_step = the page's rules rows 2..9, 4 bits each (COUNT OUT, PIN, SUBMISSION, TKO, ROPE BREAK, DQ, BLOODSHED, row 9); rr_next = row 10 | row 11 << 4 | the new save's Rumble slot given the defaults << 8 (bs_tries there, meant as the page's rows 0..7 as shown from *0x80159D0C, read 0 in run 2026-11-25_222538: not the page's rows -- the RULES shot is what shows TIME COUNT).
